answer.text: Tooth 5 compared wall-clock and flaked under load (95 vs 127, then 201 vs 169 on the same code). Cause measured: a warm hit re-listed every recorded directory (~1316 per hit) and was not run under the journal pin inspect() opens. Fix in proof_coverage.py: a listed directory records its mtime and a hit re-lists it only when the mtime moved or is racy (cache version 2). Clause 1 rewritten to a count: the warm pass, pinned and primed as inspect() runs, lists only the chain berth root, at most once per stage per ticket; findings identical; times printed. Red on main's code (9294 listings, 6 dirs outside the berth root), green with the fix (8256). Also: the cache-berth proof rooted at parents[5] (the package dir), redding test_a_proof_roots_its_imports_at_its_own_checkout; now parents[6].
